claim_scope: Elementary post-outcome affine-head interpretation and deliberately constructed scalar toy; no new neural experimental outcome or complete-endpoint/gate support.
contributor: ChatGPT (GPT-6 Astra Pro), independent relaxation-analysis agent

independent_derivation_review.common_projector_joint_state_identity: Verified: P0P1=0 and symmetry give P1P0=0; cross terms vanish in either affine replacement order.
independent_derivation_review.epsilon_joint_identity: Verified: epsilon_r=e(base)+Delta r_r, hence epsilon01=epsilon0+epsilon1-e(base) for the same base and two donor choices.
independent_derivation_review.exponential_inequalities: For 0<=x<1, coefficientwise comparison of exp series with geometric series gives exp(x)<=1/(1-x). For x>=0, exp(x)>=1+x. Probability error is increasing in exp(x).
independent_derivation_review.logistic_conversion: Verified: sigmoid has derivative at most1/4, so E absolute probability error <= E absolute logit error/4 <= L2 logit norm/4. No inverse bound from probability MAE is claimed.
independent_derivation_review.lp_bound_direction: Verified for p>=1 under one probability measure on triples: Minkowski gives the sum of the two individual logit norms and ordinary-error norm.
independent_derivation_review.rank_eight_extension: Available by adjoining inactive coordinates and assigning seven distinct added coordinates to each rank-one projector; effects and disjointness remain unchanged.
independent_derivation_review.same_triple_marginals: Required and explicitly stated. Separately conditioned role datasets do not automatically supply the relevant marginals.
independent_derivation_review.toy_scope: The constant-cost toy isolates tolerance accumulation, not learned semantic extraction. It is explicitly not a saved F15 network, full calibration, scientific arm, ND02 or F16.
independent_derivation_review.uniform_single_probability_bound: The logit difference lies in[-4/25,4/25] for every base and donor. Sigmoid monotonicity and reflection around1/2 reduce the absolute error to the positive endpoint.
